observation_scope: Synthetic public MCP initialize and tools/list, plus bounded research API GETs. This is a dated connection inventory, not a test of every tool or a source freshness assessment.

products.name: LiquiLens
products.scope: Covered-bank disclosures, institution research and corporate funding transmission
products.access: Public read-only research. Coverage differs by institution and source; discovery does not establish current evidence for every bank.

products.name: Seiche
products.scope: Funding, money-market and cross-market research context
products.access: Public research. Source clocks, units, availability and redistribution rights remain source-specific.

products.name: Undertow
products.scope: Market liquidity, venue depth and hypothetical size-specific exit research
products.access: Public discovery and summaries; full-fidelity and subscriber tools keep their own entitlements. Advertised tool count does not mean every tool is freely callable.

example.scope: At most three rows per selected dataset; next_offset indicates more rows. Preserve unavailable and withheld values.

research_api.optional_measurement: Separate opt-in enrollment and deletion routes exist; these connection examples do not enroll installations.

review_workflow.purpose: Recurring human review of covered-bank, funding and liquidity evidence
review_workflow.boundary: Attention ordering is not approval of a financial action. Check coverage, source dates, rights and gaps before interpreting values.

limitations: Connection success and advertised tools do not establish source freshness, complete coverage or customer adoption.
These public research tools do not place orders, transfer funds or provide executable quotes.
Client configuration examples were checked against documented formats; installation in each client was not exercised by this observation.
